subject: Discovery recap — pick deep-dive window & bridge preference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap — pick deep-dive window & bridge preference

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciate the context on your latency-sensitive batch scoring use case. Quick recap and the ask:

Key notes from today:
- Volume: ~15M records/month for initial phase, spiking to ~45M within Q2.
- SLO: 95th pct latency under 50ms for online scoring; nightly bulk reruns ok to be minutes-level.
- Data constraints: PHI-adjacent, needs VPC/private deployment and customer-managed KMS.

Proposed next step:
1) Technical deep-dive (30–45 min) with your infra and our inference team to align on network topology, KV cache strategy, and quantization tradeoffs.
2) Helpful if procurement can join briefly (for contract timing).

Please reply with your preferred window (all times PST):
- Tue Nov 3: 9:30–11:30 or 15:00–16:30
- Wed Nov 4: 10:00–12:00
- Thu Nov 5: 13:00–16:00

Also let us know whether you prefer Google Meet (we can use your org meet link) or Zoom (we’ll send a Zoom link). Finally, please confirm attendees from your side (I have you and Lars on the thread).

I attached a short one-pager on Redwood performance profiles and a draft proposed scope to help the deep-dive.

Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood_overview_onepager.pdf; proposed_scope-draft.docx

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the recap and for sending the docs — helpful. Quick answers:
- Best windows for us are Wed Nov 4 10:00–11:00 or Thu Nov 5 14:00–15:00 PST.
- We prefer Google Meet (we can host if that simplifies SSO/certs).
- Attendees: Emma Johnson (data lead), Lars Mikkelsen (infra), Priya Shah (security — may join if the agenda includes KMS/VPC), and myself. If Priya can't make the call, she’ll follow up asynchronously.

Can you hold Wed 10:00–11:00? If not, Thu 14:00–15:00 works.

On procurement timing: we have a standard 60–90 day procurement runway for larger contracts; I’ll loop our procurement owner after the technical alignment.

Thanks,
